_comment: SSOT for appbox default assets (grill ruling, 2026-08-09). Designer merges intake uploads over these defaults and emits the merged folder + manifest with the design. Scaffolder reads ONLY this manifest to wire google_fonts, flutter_launcher_icons config, pubspec asset registration, and the app's appbox_kit_assets.dart. Intake always asks for a brand png + svg (svg optional); user-provided entries REPLACE defaults in the emitted folder.
